# markschema / mdshape — Playground

> Interactive playground for mdshape, a TypeScript library for type-safe Markdown validation.

## About

The markschema playground lets you write Markdown on the left, define a schema on the right, and validate in real time. It runs entirely in the browser.

## Links

- Playground: https://playground.markschema.com
- Docs: https://docs.markschema.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/markschema/markschema
- npm: @markschema/mdshape

## What is mdshape?

mdshape is a TypeScript library that lets you define schemas for Markdown documents. Think of it as Zod or Yup for Markdown — it parses and validates the structure of .md files, extracting typed data you can trust.

## Use Cases

- RAG Pipelines: Validate Markdown before feeding it into retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.
- PDF-to-Markdown: Verify converted PDFs match expected structure.
- Documentation Standards: Enforce consistent structure across docs.

## Quick Example

```typescript
import { md } from '@markschema/mdshape'

const schema = md.document({
  title: md.heading(1),
  overview: md.section('Overview').fields({
    Name: md.string().min(1),
    License: md.enum(['MIT', 'Apache-2.0', 'GPL-3.0']),
  }),
})
```
